title: Undergraduate Syllabus v10
source: Derived from the finished IT 204 Computer Programming 2 syllabus (IT204-Programming2-EOMS-1.pdf), src/views/builder2/FormPaper.jsx (the layout and tag conventions the form prints), src/lib/syllabusModel.js (the rules the builder already enforces) and the admin catalog. docs/reference/ has no template PDF. The sample states no scores, so every value listed in `assumptions` and every rule with a `note` is a project decision for the curriculum office to confirm.
assumptions: rules[].severity (except where a note says the builder already blocks it)

institution.vision: Moved by the Spirit of the Risen Christ, La Consolacion University Philippines, envisions itself to become a catalyst for the wholistic transformational development of Catholic Augustinian Marian graduates rooted in Gospel values.

mission.lead: LCUP commits to generate and make available to all persons and communities programs and services that will enable them to:
items: exhibit academic and technical competence in their respective areas of discipline in the local and international environment;
demonstrate their knowledge, critical thinking and creativity by exploring the various avenues of learning and searching for truth;
live Gospel values in the varied aspects of their personal and professional lives;
manifest their willingness to serve specially the marginalized sector of our society;
demonstrate productivity in various areas of learning as responsible stewards of our common home and society; and
develop individuals who are resilient, inclusive, and responsive to the socio-economic realities of the Philippines and the complexities of the global environment.

insufficient.note: Fewer than this many of the faculty-written sections having anything in them is reported as 'not enough content', never as a low score.
